mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (full_name, furigana, nickname, email, live_city, age, gender, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{fullName}, #{furigana}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{liveCity}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, false)
INSERT INTO students_courses (student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE students_courses SET course_name= #{courseName}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate} WHERE id = #{id}
